digest.key_takeaway:
While Brazil's government announces national AI supercomputers, many developers here still can't pay for the OpenAI API — no international card, no PIX accepted. It doesn't have to be this way.

If you are a developer in Brazil — or anywhere without easy international payment — you know the pain: OpenAI, Anthropic and others require an international credit card for API billing, and many regions simply don't have one or get declined constantly.

The practical workaround: an API gateway. You keep using the same models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and the same SDK — you just point base_url to a provider

articles.summary:

articles.title: How to Build a Professional Network for Introverts
articles.summary: The word “networking” might turn your stomach instantly. The image of a room full of strangers, awkward small talk, a stack of business cards that ends up abandoned in a drawer, and your energy completely drained within an hour — all of it feels like a nightmare for an introvert. You may have long believed that building a network is a game for extroverts who are good talkers and easy to get along with, while you are doomed to fall behind because you are more comfortable with a few close friends. articles.title: How to Overcome Burnout Before It Wrecks Your Career
articles.summary: At first you did not notice it. You just felt a little more tired than usual, a little more reluctant to open your laptop, a little more easily irritated when a work notification arrived on the weekend. You told yourself, “This is just ordinary fatigue, it will pass.” But weeks turned into months, and that “ordinary fatigue” morphed into an emptiness that clung to you even after eight hours of sleep. articles.title: How to Stay Productive While Working from Home (WFH)
articles.summary: At first it sounds like a dream: working from home, no traffic jams, no need to dress neatly from head to toe, free to brew coffee whenever you like. But after a few weeks, the dream starts to crack. The bed calls out to you, social media notifications tempt you, household chores scream to be done, and suddenly it’s already late afternoon while your to-do list is still full.
